page.overview:
Who is Eliza McTarry?

Eliza McTarry was the pseudonym of a Smersh agent masquerading as a daughter of the late "MI5" head, Lord McTarry. Portrayed by British actress Gabriella Licudi, the character appeared in the 1967 parody spy film, Casino Royale.

Eliza was one of a dozen female Smersh agents involved in "Smersh Plan B" - a scheme to destroy the reputation of their celibate, upstanding spy nemesis, Sir James Bond. After the sudden death of Lord McTarry, the head of the British secret service, Eliza was dispatched to the Laird's Scottish residence alongside her handler Agent Mimi and ten fellow honeytraps.

She posed as one of McTarry's daughters, and awaited the arrival of Sir James Bond as he brought condolences, and the remains of M's wig.
